revenue.source: Airbus FY2024 and FY2025 IFRS consolidated financial statements (income statement); FY2025 press release 19 Feb 2026

operating_income.source: EBIT (reported), Airbus FY2024 and FY2025 results press releases (not EBIT Adjusted)

d_and_a.source: Cash flow statement D&A, Airbus FY2024 FS (2023, 2024) and FY2025 FS (2025)

capex.source: Purchases of intangible assets, PP&E, investment property, cash flow statement; FY2024 FS (2023: 3,051; 2024: 3,669), FY2025 FS (3,964)

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2026 guidance of ~870 deliveries vs 793 in 2025 (+~10%) implies solid growth, moderated by mix/FX; fading toward long-term growth as the production ramp (A320 rate 75) matures. Backlog 8,754 aircraft.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 reported margin 8.3% (6,082/73,420), adjusted 9.7% (7,128); FY2026 guidance EBIT Adjusted ~7.5bn (~9.5% of ~78bn). Held at 9.5% with no further expansion, conservative given tariffs and Space charges.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: blended French/German/Spanish/Dutch statutory rates ~25-30%; reported effective rate recently ~25% (FY2024 income tax 1,347).

capex_pct_revenue.source: FY2025 actual 5.4% (3,964/73,420), FY2024 5.3%; slightly lower as ramp-up capex normalises, still above D&A.

wacc.source: Assumption: risk-free ~3% (EUR), beta ~1.2, ERP ~5.5% gives cost of equity ~9.6%; net cash balance sheet so low debt weight. Airbus's own impairment pre-tax WACC is 9.1% (FY2025 FS).

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run euro-area inflation ~2%, mature duopoly aerospace market.

net_debt.source: Financing liabilities 9,063 LT + 5,186 ST = 14,249 (FY2025 FS) minus lease liabilities 2,053 LT + 327 ST (Q1 2026 FS comparatives at 31 Dec 2025) = 11,869 debt ex-leases; minus gross cash 27,218 (cash 14,128 + current securities 3,093 + non-current securities 9,997). Negative = net cash. Note: Airbus reported net cash 12,171 includes leases.

diluted_shares.source: Weighted average ordinary shares (diluted) 790,892,128, Airbus FY2025 IFRS financial statements, Note 18; in millions
